name: SISO Component Bank
summary: An offline, queryable index of 8,538 21st.dev UI components: per-component metadata, 7,975 previews, real TSX source for 6,212 (5,210 from the CDN pass, 3,507 from the shadcn-registry pass with classification axes), a hand-curated layer with verbatim human feedback, and the harvester and query scripts that built it.

relationships.context: Curated under the Research section as a durable reuse index over an external component corpus.

evidence.summary: The README defines the layers, counts, index row shape, agent query path and the rights boundary.

relationships.context: Answers the reusable-component form of the best-primitive question: for a named UI need, which existing component is best, with preview and source in hand.

evidence.summary: The scout rubric rates bank-fit on craft, mechanism, product-fit, robbability and taste-match, 0-25.

relationships.context: The legacy/ layer is the 2026-04-22 design-system pull that lived in SISO Knowledge; the CDN layer was harvested independently on 2026-08-29.

evidence.summary: How-it-was-built section records both passes, their dates and why neither supersedes the other (562 components exist only in legacy).
index.jsonl was generated by joining meta, previews, source and legacy on author/slug: 8,538 rows, 852 authors, 6,212 with any source, 2,505 with both, 3,507 with classification.
Every source/ directory carries a source-meta.json receipt; the 2,744 without code.tsx record the outcome (gated-404, parse-failure, page-soft404) rather than hiding it.
Local absolute paths were rewritten to repo-relative in 26 receipts and 2 scripts; no credentials or private infrastructure references remain.

Public repository holds index.jsonl, meta/, previews/, source/, legacy/, curated/, harvest.mjs, find.mjs and catalog-site/; 46,963 files; head commit read via the GitHub API immediately before this record was written.

license.reason: The index, scripts, curation and metadata are SISO-authored and carry MIT; each component's code belongs to its 21st.dev author and every row carries the upstream URL.

evidence.summary: MIT license text is present at the exact release pin.

addressable.reason: The public repository is pinned to an exact commit.

archive_downloadable.reason: A commit-scoped public source archive is recorded and resolved.

manifest_resolvable.reason: The release resolves to its Work, one exact artifact and the README that defines the contents.

installable.reason: Query scripts run with Node 20+ from the repo root; the catalog-site build and curated board were exercised locally before publication but no disposable-root install receipt is recorded.

forkable.reason: The public repository is source-complete for everything SISO authored and documents the upstream-rights boundary.

portable.reason: Scripts resolve paths relative to the repo (BANK_ROOT override for build.mjs); 26 receipts and 2 scripts were rewritten from absolute paths, and no other environment coupling was found.
